decisions.decision: Use evidence-search-core as the product-neutral query and provider execution kernel.
decisions.rationale: Prevents Searchright and Sourceright from maintaining divergent retry, cache, receipt and egress implementations.

decisions.decision: Integrate CiteWeft only through the optional searchright-citeweft adapter and neutral DocumentEvidence contract.
decisions.rationale: Keeps extraction evidence, review workflow and citation canonicalisation as separate domains.

decisions.decision: Map one roadmap epic to track issues and each four-phase Conductor plan to native GitHub subissues.
decisions.rationale: Preserves Conductor as source of truth while enabling observable remote planning without flattening the hierarchy.

decisions.decision: Deny network, external writes, telemetry and irreversible agent authority by default.
decisions.rationale: Systematic-search inputs include hostile text, credentials, licensed access and consequential eligibility decisions.

decisions.decision: Use an evidence ladder and require receipts before promoting implementation or public claims.
decisions.rationale: Source completeness, successful compilation, fixture behavior, live behavior and external acceptance are distinct facts.

decisions.decision: Use pinned integration passports and consumer-driven contracts instead of Git submodules or copied implementation code.
decisions.rationale: Independent repositories need reversible upgrades, explicit ownership and drift detection without coupled release histories.

decisions.decision: Keep CiteWeft and other host-specific integrations in non-publishable leaf adapters until registry-backed dependencies and downstream receipts exist.
decisions.rationale: The publishable facade and shared kernel must not acquire an unpublished Git-only dependency or imply integration maturity.
